page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-96 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture and is equipped with 756.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial memory capacity alongside a high count of dedicated processing cores.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high density of dedicated vCPUs and memory resources positions this instance for enterprise-scale workloads, offering a qualitative balance of compute power and memory capacity without the overhead of bundled local storage or specialized GPU accelerators.

Appropriate workloads for the c4d-highmem-96 instance include large-scale databases, memory-intensive data processing, enterprise applications, and memory-bound simulation tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, while the 756.0 GB memory capacity supports large in-memory datasets and complex analytical queries.
